The episode-prep-generator workflow ran end to end. Full report below.

**Path used:** Research-inference (no prior transcript found)

**Title confirmed:** Ryan Suchala is EVP and Chief Banking Officer, First United Bank & Trust Company (promoted March 24, 2025). Cross-confirmed across Bankers Digest, ZoomInfo, and LinkedIn search results.

**Step 1 (Obsidian search):** No prior recorded conversation with Ryan Suchala exists in the vault. Only passing mentions turned up: a referral aside in a 2026-07-16 club membership consultation transcript, a YPO board note, and a Napa trip attendee list — none are conversation records, so I didn't treat them as a source.

**Step 2 (guest research) — flag worth your attention:** His career and title are well-documented (nearly 20 years in banking, 17 years at BOK Financial/Bank of Texas before joining First United ~7+ years ago, Dallas 500 honoree in 2022), but there's zero public footprint on AI, technology, or compliance specifically — no speaking history, no interviews, no quotes on the episode's actual topic, and no public First United statement on AI strategy. I flagged this plainly in the prep sheet rather than inventing a point of view for him.

**Prep sheet contents:**
- 9 numbered questions across 4 clusters (Where AI Shows Up in Regional Banking, Compliance and Regulatory Guardrails, The CBO's View, What's Real vs. Hype), with lettered follow-ups
- Guest research brief (sourced, ~1 page)
- Suggested Flow section, clearly labeled as career-based inference, not a quote — since there's no transcript or on-record commentary to draw from
- No Internal Context section (none was provided as an input)
- Notes section documenting the transcript search (not found), the research gap, and a recommendation that whoever books the episode confirm his actual AI initiatives directly before recording, since public sources won't surface them

**One recommendation before this goes further:** given the thin footprint, I'd loop in whoever's coordinating with Ryan to get a quick pre-interview line on what he's actually doing with AI at First United — that will sharpen questions 1, 3, and 6 significantly. Worth doing before this feeds into `podcast-prep`.
